objective: Transport the unchanged E9 models and early local policies to all 36 ancillary binary records; diagnose exact local risk without selecting a replacement policy.
scope: Retrospective external acquisition/protocol transport within one laboratory; no direct FD intervention and no new-laboratory validation.
known: E9 outcomes known. Ancillary input metadata inspected in discovery; prediction scores not inspected before this freeze.
model_rule: Use all 12 frozen E9 model coefficient sets and their TRAIN standardizers/cuts. No refit, penalty selection, or alignment selection.
dependence: Same-day files and consecutive clock segments may share cells. Namespaced cell IDs do not imply independence; report each day/clock/horizon/alignment separately.
temporal_rule: Inherit E9 35% early, 65% validation, 20-minute origin purge, five-minute stride, horizons 5/10/20, both alignments. Report empty stages, do not alter cutoffs.
jurisdiction_rule: Context > cell and context > pulse-age x TRAIN signal-band; retain their intersections with three equal duration LATE-origin segments. Segment cutpoints use timestamps only. Preserve all low-support nodes.
effect_rule: Same atomic late support; thresholds 0%,1%,5% are descriptive sensitivity, not statistical significance. Report RMSE, MAE, q95 and exact squared-error difference.
mechanism: For constant cell correction c and mean baseline error mu: deltaMSE=c*c-2*c*mu. Sign reversal c*mu<=0 and overshoot c*mu>0 but abs(c)>2*abs(mu) partition harmful nonzero corrections. This algebra is not biological causal attribution.
prospective_limit: A future mean interval [L,U] would allow minimax c=projection of zero onto [L,U]. No valid future interval is assumed or estimated from these test outcomes; no oracle policy deployed.

gates.G2: all file schemas and consensus inputs, no duplicate track/time
gates.G3: same inherited window and causal features
gates.G4: no refit; all 216 contexts or explicit NOT_ESTIMABLE
gates.G5: atomic algebra and nested conservation; both alignments and local harms
gates.G6: independent metric reconstruction and numerical identities
gates.G7: Drive complete readback, public code/report without manuscripts
gates.G8: conditional future-policy guarantee unavailable without a justified future-mean bound; direct FD gate not met
